items.title: Avery "Kid" Howard Interview, 1961-05-22
items.q: I played with Willie Parker's band. ... I used to work with his band.

ctx.x: What other clubs did you work for?

The Illinois Club, that's my first club. I played with Willie Parker's band. He used to get the job at the time he used to play the bass drum. I used to work with his band. I mean he'd get the job, you know, Moose never got the job that was their band.
